profile.name: Newport 1830C光功率计
profile.description: 这是一款用于测量光功率的台式光功率计，可通过串口进行远程控制，读取功率数据，并设置波长、量程、平均滤波、归零、参考值以及前面板相关参数，适用于激光与光学实验中的功率监测和校准。
profile.description_en: This is a benchtop optical power meter for measuring optical power. It supports remote serial control to read power data and configure wavelength, measurement range, averaging filter, zeroing, reference level, and front-panel settings, making it suitable for power monitoring and calibration in laser and optical experiments.
